observations.boundary: Browser performance.now around a batch of actual WASM decodeChunks calls. Each call includes JS/WASM chunk copies, parser construction/push/output, JSON serialization and function-local cleanup. Input-chunk construction, output-array allocation, every-output validation and digests are outside the clock. Values are batch elapsed divided by calls; quantiles describe batch means, not individual-call latency. Synthetic pushes are not actual browser reads. No HTTP/provider/app rendering.
observations.quantile_method: Median p50 and nearest-rank p95/p99 of24 batch means per cell. At n=24 p99 is maximum. Each point is a per-call batch average, not individual-call latency or production tail.
observations.source_context: Complete browser WASM decoder bridge matrix only. Each call includes JS/WASM chunk copying, parser construction/push/output and JSON serialization. The HTTP matrix is checked separately from study02; this run contains no action HTTP timing, provider, app renderer or T3-equivalent measurement.
